QuestInfo.name: Road of Regrets
QuestInfo.0: If the answer wasn't on #MDmirrorD_328_0_# then maybe it would be on the #MDmirrorD_328_1_#? #p2480000# suggested that a priest he called the #b#p2480002##k has researched phenomena such as these.
QuestInfo.1: If visions of happiness were clouding their way, a vision of regret would surely show the answers. #p2480002# suggested they collect piece of regretful memories. The #rLilynouch#k at the end of the #b#MDmirrorD_328_1_##k would have the #b#t2431837##k they needed.\r\n\r\n#r(Tip: Forfeit the quest if you need to restart.)#k
QuestInfo.2: All those terrible events they had experienced together had become a part of them. And without real regrets to hamper their memories, they could not see the corruption. #p2480002# was helpless to do anything more.

0.0: I have seen the Goddess Teardrop... a perfect jewel created just for you. Or rather, of you. But something has corrupted you...
0.1: All people make mistakes. Whether they hold on to regret is a choice that must be made. You two are no different. Perhaps the corruption stems from regret, and the memories still cling to your minds.

yes.0: Hunt the #rLilynouch#k at the end of Road of Regrets and get a #bRegret Shard#k. You will then see the mistakes you have made.

1.0: The Road of Regrets revealed nothing? Interesting. Your regrets have been forgiven, or taken into you. Your past transgressions have washed away. I can help you no further, for you have no regrets.
1.1: Regret is a powerful emotion, one that comes when you think all bad things have past. Perhaps you will feel its sting one day...

item.0: Hunt the #rLilynouch#k at the end of Road of Regrets and get a #bRegret Shard#k. You will then see the mistakes you have made.
